purpose: Quantify which observed successive sparse 12h GPS intervals can be certified to satisfy the source paper's <=12.5h Brownian-bridge gap rule without inferring missing clock time or scoring any movement predictions.

prohibit: UTM_E or UTM_N or other spatial columns

clock_interpretations.meaning: all possible local civil times in the stated date; does not infer missing clock time
sensitivity to published ~00:00/01:00 clock schedule; not a verified actual time or filled-in dataset

observed_full_time: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS records are treated as exact local civil timestamps only; not certified absolute UTC instants
reference_clock: Mountain Time, source local wall clock. NO conversion to UTC or DST correction; ordinary subtraction can diverge from physical elapsed hours across daylight-saving transitions.
same_record_date_only_semantics: T0 is conservative range, T1 is a sensitivity scenario, neither alters source records.
sort_rule: per group ascending lower time bound, then upper bound, then original physical DBF row ordinal; pairwise order ambiguity must be reported
pair_definition: adjacent records after fixed sorting within each complete group, total expected pairs = 28953 - number of groups; no implicit cross-animal or cross-season pairs
threshold_provenance: McKee et al (2024) Ecosphere doi:10.1002/ecs2.4983; max interval 12.5 hours in both traditional 2h and sparse 12h BBMM procedures

gap_interval_math.excluded: NOT possible (pairwise temporal bridge threshold only; not biological impossibility)
gap_interval_math.global_path_warning: Independent pairwise possible edges cannot be concatenated into a globally possible trajectory without one coherent assignment to all unknown timestamps.

output: number of groups, records and adjacent pairs
per T0 and T1 counts robust, contingent, excluded, ambiguous-order
counts of pairs newly robust under T1 but not T0; never mark as factual midnight recovery
counts of groups with all pairwise edges robust, and with any uncertain edge
no IDs, exact dates, raw times, coordinates, sample trajectories, model scores
stops: source ZIP hash or member structure fails
unexpected timestamp format or missing group key
any interpreted UTC/DST time adjustment or nonfrozen threshold
any 2h access or ecological prediction attempt
